_note: Model routing configuration. Generated by migrate-to-routing-config.py from endpoints.json v1.

vision_extraction.description: When image input arrives and the downstream model is not vision_capable, route the image through a vision-capable extractor. The 'slot' field (preferred) names a slot in the 'slots' block — typically 'image_generates' — whose preferred + fallback chain is reused. Image-generation models accept image conditioning by construction, so the same model that generates images can also extract spatial structure from them. This avoids carving out a separate vision_extractors bucket. The preferred_extractor_bucket / fallback_extractor_bucket fields are the legacy bucket-based fallback, used when no slot is configured OR when the slot's chain has no vision-input-capable entry (e.g. entirely pure-text-to-image generators like local-diffusers / stability). Final fallback to manual-trace UX (WP-4.4) when nothing resolves.

web_supplement.description: Step 2.5 anticipatory web-supplement loop. When enabled, the fast model in the step1_cleanup slot (typically Haiku) decides whether the prompt needs external information beyond the vault and conversation history. If yes, it produces up to max_gaps specific gaps each with a DDG query, runs up to max_attempts_per_gap search-and-evaluate cycles per gap (first attempt is site:-filtered to high-provenance trusted domains from Reference — Trusted Web Sources, subsequent attempts drop the filter for general DDG), and assembles the retained chunks into a ## WEB CONTEXT block in the analyst system prompt. Set enabled to false to disable entirely; the pipeline then runs vault-only RAG as before, with the existing mid-analysis Supplemental RAG Protocol still available as a fallback inside the analyst loop.

image_generates._note: General-purpose image generation slot. Serves news photos, illustration filler, and the eventual data-viz illustration fallback. Preferred = openai-gpt-image-1 (artistic richness, moderation-lottery on boundary-pushing prompts); Fallback 1 = Gemini 2.5 Flash Image (catches OpenAI safety_violations refusals); Fallback 2 = local-diffusers (SD 1.5 last-resort if both cloud providers fail). The registry's invoke() walks the chain on prompt_rejected / model_unavailable / quota_exceeded — see capability_registry.fallback_triggering_codes. Hector cartoons go through a separate slot (`image_generates_cartoon`) so the Hector LoRA is only ever invoked through the cartoon path. DALL-E references removed 2026-05-12 per OpenAI's same-day shutdown announcement.

image_generates_cartoon._note: Hector Rentier editorial-cartoon slot (introduced 2026-05-12). Preferred = openai-gpt-image-1 for artistic richness on the engraved-woodcut aesthetic; Fallback = civitai-hector-lora-v1, the publisher-trained Hector Style v1 LoRA on Flux.2 Klein 9B-base (Civitai model 2616013 / version 2937250) which holds the §5.4.1 'no facial features ever' spec line by construction. Cascade triggers: registry.invoke() falls through on prompt_rejected (gpt-image-1 moderation refusal), quota_exceeded, or model_unavailable. Note: a successful-but-spec-violating render from gpt-image-1 (eyes/noses added onto butt-face figures) is NOT caught by the cascade — that requires a post-render verifier, which is separate work. Per §5.8.1 v1.9 publisher decision: image quality wins; LoRA is the safety net when OpenAI refuses or errors.
